calls.title: Hims & GrowthBook - AI Capabilities
calls.summary: The team discussed the development of agentic tooling aimed at streamlining access to experiment insights and simplifying future experiment creation. Eric Sokolov demoed an AI agent tool capable of analyzing past experiments using cloud code and SQL, generating actionable insights and recommendations. A feedback loop for hypothesis generation was envisioned, with plans for minimal human oversight. Current challenges include inconsistent experiment metadata and API integration. Discussion also covered MCP server capabilities and the importance of guardrails for data quality alongside user experience. Plans were made to collaborate with AI-focused engineers to improve messaging and recommendation systems, while ensuring robust metadata management and structured experiment definitions.
calls.keywords: Experimentation, AI tooling, GrowthBook, Cloud code, Taxonomy, MCP server
